trailhead.label: Muntarütsch car park above Samedan, the board’s start

cautions: Upper-village roads at the end: lead short for passing cars.
Forest path with roots and short steep stretches above Muntarütsch.
Hay meadows near Samedan are closed 15 May–30 September: keep to the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
